description: The Kennedy Center began dismantling a large stick figure sculpture on its grounds today. title: Kennedy Center has dismantled ‘Blue’ sculpture

author: CNN
description:
Trump administration efforts to force change in the handling of election ballots may be facing a bigger hurdle than the cross-country court challenges and resistance: With just 62 days to go before midterm elections, election officials insist it is simply too late for them to even try to comply with the proposed rules.

In court filings and interviews with CNN, election officials and other mail voting experts said that there is no practical way to comply with the Postal Service’s plans – even if states can find the millions of dollars they expect compliance to cost.

"This system cannot be implemented consistent with the right to vote," Sen. Richard Blumenthal (D-CT) told CNN, adding that the new rules are "haphazard," "negligent" and "intentional."

0:00 State election officials warn that they can't meet new proposed mail-in ballot rules
1:07 CNN's Alayna Treene reports from the White House
3:41 "What's at stake is the right to vote": Sen. Richard Blumenthal on whistleblower report
5
title: 'Designed to fail': States warn they can't meet Trump mail ballot demands

description: In an elaborate scheme, federal prosecutors say 35-year-old Daejon Labrayae Love scammed women by pretending to be an NFL player for the 49ers. Love and his alleged co-conspirator, 18-year-old Taylor Jamie Chan, have been charged with wire fraud and conspiracy to commit wire fraud, according to investigators. Love appeared in court in Boise, Idaho, on August 27, and is being transferred to Oregon for further hearings. Chan has elected to have a preliminary hearing in Oregon.
